claims.statement: Unit tests run tests/unit/**/*.test.{ts,tsx} with Vitest in the Node environment using tsconfig path aliases.
Integration tests run real Payload against Postgres with a global setup, serially across files, with a 30 second test timeout and 120 second hook timeout.
The integration global setup starts the embedded database if needed and resets ta_web_integration when no DATABASE_URL is set, applies migrations with pnpm migrate, and stops any database it started.
Integration helpers start Payload with getPayload, build an in-memory 1x1 PNG, and create and log in a panel user with a role that defaults to administrator.

E2E servers build the app unless E2E_SKIP_BUILD is 1, reset the E2E database when using the embedded database, run migrations, seed the test guides, clear Next's data cache and start the production server on the configured port.
The E2E config uses port 3100 by default, Chromium only, and in CI one worker, one retry and forbidOnly.
With SMOKE_BASE_URL set Playwright starts no local servers and tests that URL, reading the variable only from the process environment.
The @smoke subset covers the home page, the Payload admin, /api/health without a db field and /api/ready with the database ok.
Outside dev, robots.txt allows indexing except /admin and the home page carries no X-Robots-Tag.
The dev environment suite starts one app instance with APP_ENV=dev, reusing the build when E2E_SKIP_BUILD is set.
A unit test pins that integration and E2E environments point DATABASE_URL_DIRECT at the test database, and that E2E treats a blank DATABASE_URL as empty.
Unit tests include a quests-collection test that pins the quests collection's field shapes, including the zone, achievement, rewards and needs groups, and its access functions.

The integration suite includes tests/integration/migrations.test.ts, which runs pnpm payload migrate:down then pnpm payload migrate with integrationEnv and DATABASE_CONNECTION=direct to check the migrations roll back and re-apply, after saving rows that use enum values later migrations added.

The DofusDB client unit tests use an injected fake fetch, sleep, log and random, so they check paging, field selection, query lookups, ID chunking, pauses, retries and errors without reaching the network or waiting.

Unit tests pin quest mapping, zone, achievement and the prerequisite rule, and that fetchQuestData looks up by ID only the NPCs and maps named in start positions and their sub-areas and areas, while fetching the whole monster and item catalogs, every dungeon, every achievement and every achievement category with select lists.

The refresh-quests integration test runs refreshQuests three times: the first creates the fixture quests and skips missing prerequisites, the second changes nothing and keeps refreshedAt, and the third updates only what changed and links a prerequisite that now exists; a second block does the same for items, monsters, rewards and needs, and the test removes its fixture rows before and after.
DofusDB fixtures in tests/fixtures/dofusdb hold quests, NPCs and map positions shared by the DofusDB unit tests and the refresh integration test.

Unit tests pin the quest-guides collection's fields, versions, hooks, validateGuideTitle, validateGuideSlug, validateSlug and access functions, and each guide body block's fields, validateVideoUrl and validateStepCoordinate.

The quest-guides access integration test checks that anonymous reads hide drafts and cannot write, that a panel user can publish a draft and get a version, and that a guide with its body blocks, its linked quest and an image saves and reads back, deleting all guides, quests and media afterwards.
The migrations integration test sets its own 180-second timeout because it starts the Payload CLI twice.

Import unit tests cover page parsing (title, desktop grid order, text, image and unknown blocks), the page-to-guide conversion with steps and recommendations, releasing the shared DOM, HTML to Lexical through Payload's editor, the quest matches CSV and the image download rules.
tests/fixtures/squarespace holds trimmed copies of the five demo Squarespace pages, one HTML file per slug, and Prettier ignores the directory.

The import-fetch-image unit test uses an injected fake fetch to check that the image fetcher refuses http, other hosts, an internal IP, localhost and a look-alike subdomain without making a request, refuses non-image and HTTP error responses, and does not follow redirects.

The import-quest-guides integration test runs the loader on the five fixture pages with a fake fetchImage that returns a 1x1 PNG, checks drafts with blocks, images and the existing quest, one media record per image, oddities, an idempotent second run, one new draft for a changed guide, a summary field that disappears being filled from the linked quest without extra versions on the next run, hidden drafts for anonymous readers, skipping an invalid slug, a guide with several DofusDB IDs saved without a quest, steps with marker titles as bold paragraphs and fight lists turned into fight blocks, and cleans up before and after.

The game-data-collections unit test pins the items, monsters and npcs slugs, admin settings and field shapes including the imported images, that the collections Torre corrects no longer use the read-only gameDataAccess, and that sub-areas are read by anyone, edited only by an administrator and limited by scopeSubAreaWrite to their zone background on a panel save.

The quest-rewards unit test checks the level-200 XP and kamas against Torre's and dofusdb.fr's figures, the 1.5x optimal-level cap, per-step flooring, the last reward entry per step, items summed across steps and emote and title IDs.

The quest-needs unit test checks delivered and need.items items, the larger-quantity rule, every fight and soul objective, walksMaps for map and sub-area discovery, and that talking to NPCs, free-form and crafting objectives are ignored.

The game-data-access integration test shows an anonymous request can find and findByID items, monsters, achievements and achievement categories, while a panel user gets Forbidden on create and delete, and an update either is refused (achievement categories) or saves only Torre's correction, leaving the DofusDB data unchanged.
The quests-steps, items and monsters fixtures hold nine quests with steps plus exactly the items and monsters they name, used by the rewards, needs, fetch and refresh tests.

The concurrency unit test checks that mapWithConcurrency keeps input order, never exceeds limit running tasks, runs tasks in order with limit 1, rejects with the first error after running tasks settle without starting more, returns an empty list for empty input, and rejects a limit below 1 or not an integer.
The dofusdb-write-concurrency unit test checks that an empty or unset DOFUSDB_WRITE_CONCURRENCY gives a default below 10, that positive integers are read, and that 0, -2, 1.5 and ocho throw.

A third refresh-quests integration block runs the refresh over both fixtures with concurrency 1 and then with concurrency 8 and expects equal counts and equal stored data, comparing relationships by DofusDB ID.

A fourth refresh-quests integration block feeds the fixture items plus items no quest names, expects every item created with its superTypeId, and expects a second run with the same catalog to write no item and keep refreshedAt.

The items-unreferenced fixture holds three DofusDB items no fixture quest names, a sword of supertype 2 and two quest items of supertype 14, used to test that the whole item catalog is fetched and stored.

The guide-summary unit test builds linked quests from the DofusDB fixtures and checks the generated rewards and prerequisites against Torre's parsed Squarespace pages, the needed items without quest items, the fill rules and every summary note state.
The guide-autofill unit test covers slugFromName, availableSlug suffixes, the SEO templates and 160-character cut, autofillFromQuest never touching written fields, and linkedQuestId.

The quest-guides-autofill integration test saves guides through the local API as a panel user and checks the title, slug, SEO and summary fill from DofusDB, the slug suffix, that written values are kept, the Spanish rejection without title and quest, an imported guide keeping its slug, and an emptied summary field being filled again, deleting every guide, quest and item afterwards.

The needs-list-migration integration test calls the needs_list migration's down and up directly on the migrated integration database and checks that text in the old columns of a guide and its version becomes summary.needs.notes with an empty item list.
The guide-summary unit test checks that requiredLevel gives a level for a PL> joined by & and none for a PL> among | alternatives.

The guide-form-fill unit test checks that plannedFormFill plans every empty field from the quest and nothing for written fields, and that stillEmpty drops fields and a needs list typed during the slug check while still filling what stays empty, treating whitespace-only text and an empty list as empty.
The dofusdb-criterion unit test checks that requiredTerms returns the terms joined by &, nothing from a level with |, the terms inside &-only brackets, and nothing for a null or empty criterion.

The guide-single-quest-migration integration test calls the guide_single_quest migration's down and up directly on a guide linked to one quest, checks after down that the quest is a relation row for the guide and its version, adds a second quest behind it, and checks after up, run in a finally block, that quest_id, version_quest_id and Payload's quest field on the guide and its versions hold the first quest.
appWebServers treats a blank or whitespace-only DATABASE_URL as unset and then uses the embedded Postgres and the ta_web_e2e database.
playwright.config.ts passes E2E_DESIGN_CATALOG=1 to the E2E app server so the production build serves the /sistema catalog during the tests.

tests/e2e/sistema.spec.ts checks the /sistema catalog in every theme and mode, including coordinate and item name copy, hit targets, the video facade, the fullscreen viewer and axe WCAG 2.2 AA checks.
pnpm test:lhci is a separate suite that runs Lighthouse CI on the production path with its own ta_web_lhci database.
The ui-components and game-components unit tests render the design system components with renderToStaticMarkup and check their markup.

The E2E seed publishes Seis pies bajo tierra with steps, zone, achievement, XP range, NPC renders and a content date, its prerequisite's guide and an unpublished draft, seeds the La ocasión hace al ladrón achievement page in the Astrub metalogro and two Alineamiento achievements without quests, seeds the Dofus Ocre, Dofawa and a preparing Jyfus Dofus guides with the index intro, seeds the Nebuloso, Hielos and Silvestre checklists, extra index entries including the Ocre souls draft and the poster art, the standalone pages including links to Torre's site and a tutorial with a long table, and a slug redirect, and creates local panel users for the preview and panel tests.

The guia, brand and fonts E2E specs cover the public guide page and preview, the emblem and favicon links, and that only the Montserrat and Rowdies files are preloaded with every Montserrat weight from its file.
Integration tests cover the panel login lockout, the guide page queries and the NPC refresh with a fake renderer.

The import-disconnect integration test runs its fault-injection fixture through pnpm payload run and passes only when the fixture prints RECOVERY_OK after surviving a killed Postgres backend during an import and reconciling on the next load.

The import-disconnect fixture refuses to inject faults unless faultInjectionRefusal allows it: any local database of the integration suite is accepted whatever its name, while a non-local URL, the pnpm db:dev database and a run outside pnpm test:integration are refused, and the test asserts those three refusals.
E2E specs cover the achievement page, the metalogros index, the site header and search, and the home page with its hero search.

Integration tests cover the achievement pages and queries, the achievement refresh and import, game image import, the guide search index, the site counts, the guides backfill and the step title migration.

The achievement-fixes integration test covers pnpm fix:achievements: a dry run writes nothing, apply changes only the listed entries and shifts siblings in order, a second run changes nothing, and entries or siblings with unpublished drafts are skipped.
The achievement page queries integration test also checks readSearchIndex: published achievements with their metalogro and quest count and the metalogros that open, alongside the guides.
The site-shell unit test and the header and home E2E specs check that Clases and Mazmorras appear with the Próximamente tag and no link, and that the Dofus in preparation are not links.

The Dofus guides E2E spec covers the /guias-dofus index with its filter, search and no-JavaScript fallback, the seeded Dofus guide page with its step-by-step body, a 404 for a preparing Dofus, axe in both modes and the header's Dofus panel.
expectNeedsColumns checks Necesitarás items in columns with the notes below at 1440, 390 and 320 px and is shared by the guide, achievement and Dofus guide specs.

The movimiento E2E spec checks page view transitions with a still header, the reduced-motion fallback, and the entry and exit transitions of header panels, the search, the phone menu, the viewer, the video player and the metalogros tiles.

The E2E seed also creates the checklist pages, the extra /checklists index entries, the poster art, the standalone pages and a slug redirect after the guides, achievements and Dofus guides, refusing non-local databases.

Checklist E2E specs cover the checklist page, its browser progress, the merge of the old app's progress keys, the /checklists index, the Silvestre and Ocre drafts through the panel preview, and the Hielos generic row and self-finishing quest.
Panel E2E specs and integration tests cover panel roles, refused deletes of referenced documents and locked fields.
The E2E app server sets NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL to the local origin because next start requires a public origin.
panel-a11y.spec.ts runs axe WCAG 2.2 AA on five panel pages in light and dark mode with no exceptions, and panel-ola2.spec.ts covers the A-13 to A-22 panel aids with its own panel account.

The layout review lints every public page type at 390, 768, 1024, 1440 and 2560 px for a page wider than the window, overflow, clipped text, one word per line, cramped text and overlapping siblings, skipping elements marked data-layout-lint-ignore.

Playwright runs the panel spec files in their own panel project with one worker, because Payload locks a document an account has open and two files opening it with different accounts at once would collide.
The panel-refrescos E2E spec checks that an administrator sees the last refresh and the «Traer ahora» button, an editor sees the refresh without the button, and the API refuses an editor's start.
The panel-navegacion E2E spec changes the Dofus phrase of the Navegación global in the panel, checks the mobile menu shows it, and restores the built-in navigation afterwards.
New E2E specs cover the themes and theme picker, the zone background, the Ko-fi buttons, the full-width frame, printing and forced colors.

The zone background integration tests cover the endpoint's access, the cropped render stored once per map, the refresh leaving a background alone, panel saves limited to the background, the map choice and the page's own image winning, and the backfill script's dry run, apply and idempotent rerun.
There are seven suites; pnpm test:import runs the import golden pages with Vitest over tests/import/**/*.test.ts in the Node environment, and CI runs it in its own Importación job.

Playwright starts a second server, analyticsWebServer, with the same build and database on E2E_ANALYTICS_PORT (default E2E_PORT + 2) and Umami pointed at a fake .invalid host, after the main app server.

The E2E app servers put uploads in the test database's own media folder through MEDIA_STATIC_DIR, set TWITCH_LIVE_URL to off and blank both Umami variables, and a suite's own env wins over these values.
loadE2eEnvFromFile reads only E2E_PORT, E2E_DEV_GATE_PORT, E2E_ANALYTICS_PORT and E2E_SKIP_BUILD from .env, and the process environment wins.
hojas-de-estilo.spec.ts allows at most three stylesheets on every page lighthouserc.cjs measures.
The dev-gate suite sets both Umami variables and its analitica spec checks that dev renders no Umami script and sends no visit.

New E2E specs cover analytics, the no-JavaScript /buscar page, share cards and the «Actualizado el» line, external links in a new tab, an achievement page without quests, and the table block on the site and in the panel.

New integration tests cover pnpm import:delta, the Alineamiento achievement pages import, pnpm guides:summary-text, the contentUpdatedAt hook, the table block, collectLegacyLinks with readSiteIndex, and readLiveSlugs.
The fonts unit test mocks next/font/local and checks that neither src/ nor next.config.ts imports next/font/google.
The E2E seed empties the database's media folder before seeding when the database has no media rows, so leftovers of an earlier run never make Payload rename an upload.
